summary: trd-parser mapOpenQuestionColumns does not recognise the "What I assumed" header that plan.md and trd-authoring.md prescribe, so openQuestions[].assumed is empty and the assumption never reaches <open_question> in task prompts

trd-parser parseGrounding uses the FIRST heading containing "Task Grounding", so a prose heading earlier in a TRD (e.g. "### Why Task Grounding moves to code") hides the real section from report and from /implement-trd
evidence: trd-parser.js:497 findSection(lines, "Task Grounding") default strategy first, contains-match; reproduced by the review
